about: What's new, newest first (V3 gap 31). One entry per stage end or notable release, in plain words for a keen amateur. The Help door in More shows these; a dot on Help marks an entry the device has not seen. The chart room thread adds an entry as each stage of handover/design/SSE4-coming-together.md lands.

entries.title: New this week, and where to find it
items: Most of the new pictures are in True. Open the Solar System from the start sheet, then choose True under View style (the chart opens on Chart). True needs a browser that can draw with the graphics card.
Sun prominences: in True, look at the Sun's edge. The loops show only off the disc and are faint, as they are in life.
Saturn's rings have their gaps and ripple trains: in True, zoom in on Saturn to see the Encke and Keeler gaps and the density waves.
Shadows, eclipses and sea glint: in True, Saturn's shadow lies across its rings; step time to catch a moon's shadow on Jupiter; Earth's oceans catch the Sun at three-quarter light.
Press Play on the ruler and everything on screen moves on the campaign's clock, and stands still when you pause.
Energy flow: pick a world (Earth, say), open it, and open Energy flow: sunlight in, heat out, and life's share of it.
Every star has a formal class: select the Sun and its card leads with G2 V. Reference on the rail, then Classes, shows the star gallery built on them.
Small bodies: on the rail, Workshop, then Small bodies, designs an asteroid, comet, contact binary or pair, lumpy as real ones are.
Each desk remembers its own depth, view and time span. On the Run desk the place line steps Out and In, and F fills the screen with the picture.
Not seeing these? Start fresh, on the start sheet or at the top of More, forgets this browser's remembered choices (your campaign stays) or everything.

entries.title: Stage 1: a test drive you can walk
items: Open the Solar System from the start sheet, pick a world and ask why any value is what it is.
Change a world on the Build desk and watch what follows: move Mars to 1 AU and its surface warms by about 50 K. Undo takes it back.
Open any world as a globe, see its magnetic field with Mag, and cut it open with Cutaway.
Play now closes the time ruler in, so you see the days pass.
Go out to the cosmic web from the place line and come straight back down to where you were.
Look up is on the rail at every system and world: elements, substances, constants and units.
Every theme is checked for colour-blind viewers. Element origins, field lines and the accent stay apart for every common colour vision.

entries.title: Where you are, and how to get anywhere
items: The place line along the top shows where you are, from the cosmic web down to a single world. Press any step to go there.
Below, at the end of the line, lists what is inside: the worlds of a system, the systems of a campaign.
Every diagram has the same view controls: zoom and slide everywhere, and tilt and Free where the diagram has depth.
